sanskrit: imā u tvā puruvaso 'bhi pra nonavurgiraḥ . gāvo vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ
english: These songs, O Wealthy One, resound toward you in praise — like milch-cows lowing toward their calf.

sanskrit: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam . itthā candramaso gṛhe
english: Here indeed they found the secret name of the cow belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ — thus in the house of the Moon.

sanskrit: yadindro anayadrito mahīrapo vṛṣantamaḥ . tatra pūṣābhuvatsacā
english: When Indra, unhindered and most showering, led forth the great waters, there Pūṣan was present at his side.

sanskrit: gaurdhayati marutāṃ śravasyurmātā maghonām yuktā vahnī rathānām
english: The shining cow gives suck — she who is glory-seeking, the mother of the Maruts, the generous ones, harnessed as the bearer of the chariots.

sanskrit: upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate . upa no haribhiḥ sutam
english: Come to us with your tawny steeds to the pressed soma, O Lord of raptures — come to us with your tawny steeds to the pressed soma.

sanskrit: iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṃ vṛdhanto adhvare . acchāvabhṛthamojasā
english: The desired priestly libations have been poured forth, magnifying Indra at the rite — toward the concluding bath with vigor.

sanskrit: ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagraha . ahaṃ sūrya ivājani
english: I alone have grasped from the Father the wisdom of immortality — I was born like the sun.

sanskrit: revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ . kṣumanto yābhirmadema
english: Let our joint festival-joys in Indra be rich, abundantly strong — rich in wealth, by which we may rejoice.

sanskrit: somaḥ pūṣā ca cetaturviśvāsāṃ sukṣitīnām . devatrā rathyorhitā
english: Soma and Pūṣan, perceivers of all good dwellings, are yoked as charioteers in the divine realm.

sanskrit: viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratuṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
english: The all-conquering, hundred-powered, most bountiful one among men.

sanskrit: pra va indrāya mādanaṃ haryaśvāya gāyata . sakhāyaḥ somapāvne
english: Sing forth for Indra the exhilarating hymn, O friends — for the tawny-steeded, soma-drinking one.

sanskrit: vayamu tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ . kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante
english: We indeed, O Indra, for that very purpose — friends devoted to you — the Kaṇvas grow old praising you with recitations.

sanskrit: indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ . arkamarcantu kāravaḥ
english: For Indra, for his exhilaration, let our songs resound around the pressed soma — let the singers worship with the hymn.

sanskrit: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi . ehīmasya dravā piba
english: This soma of yours, O Indra, is purified upon the sacred grass — come, hasten here, drink of it.

sanskrit: surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe . juhūmasi dyavidyavi
english: For aid we invoke the beautiful craftsman, as a milker milks a good-milking cow — day by day we call.

sanskrit: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye . tṛmpā vyaśnuhī madam
english: O Bull, toward you I pour the pressed soma upon the pressing-stones for your drinking — be satisfied, spread your exhilaration wide.

sanskrit: ya indra camaseṣvā somaścamūṣu te sutaḥ . pibedasya tvamīśiṣe
english: The soma that is poured for you, O Indra, in the cups and in the vessels — you are the lord over drinking of it.

sanskrit: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe . sakhāya indramūtaye
english: At each yoking we call upon the most powerful, at each prize-contest — friends calling Indra for his aid.

sanskrit: ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabhi pra gāyata . sakhāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ
english: Come here, sit down, and sing forth to Indra — O friends who bring the hymns of praise.

sanskrit: pibā tvā3sya girvaṇaḥ
english: Drink, O you who are delighted by songs.

sanskrit: mahāṃ indraḥ puraśca no mahitvamastu vajriṇe . dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ
english: Great is Indra, and before us too let greatness belong to the thunderbolt-bearer — his might is broad like the sky.

sanskrit: ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya . mahāhastī dakṣiṇena
english: Come now, O Indra, seize and gather for us the splendid, wealth-rich prize — with your great right hand.

sanskrit: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide . sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim
english: Praise and sing forth to Indra the lord of the mountain-cows as you know him — the son of Truth, the true lord.

sanskrit: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā . kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
english: By what means shall the wondrous one, the ever-growing friend, come to us in aid — accompanied by what most powerful deed?

sanskrit: tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam . ā cyāvayasyūtaye
english: That altogether-conquering one, stretched forth in all your songs — set him in motion for your aid.

sanskrit: sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam . saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣam
english: For the wonderful lord of the assembly hall, the dear and beloved one of Indra, I have sought the winning of wisdom.

sanskrit: ye te panthā adho divo yebhirvyaśvamairayaḥ . uta śroṣantu no bhuvaḥ
english: Those paths of yours that are beneath the sky, by which you sent forth Vyaśva — may the worlds hear us too.

sanskrit: bhadraṃbhadraṃ na ā bhareṣamūrjaṃ śatakrato . yadindra mṛḍayāsi naḥ
english: Bring to us blessings upon blessings, food and strength, O Hundred-powered — when you, O Indra, show us grace.

sanskrit: asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ . uta svarājo aśvinā
english: This soma has been pressed — the Maruts drink of it, and likewise the self-ruling Aśvins.

sanskrit: vanvānāsaḥ suvīryam
english: Winning for themselves great heroic strength.

sanskrit: na ki devā inīmasi na kyā yopayāmasi . mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi
english: We do not diminish the gods, we do not obstruct anything — we walk in the hearing of sacred utterance.

sanskrit: doṣo āgādbṛhadgāya dyumadgāmannātharvaṇa . stuhi devaṃ savitāram
english: Evening has come — sing the great song, the bright song, O descendant of Atharvan — praise the god Savitṛ.

sanskrit: eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vyucchati priyā divaḥ . stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat
english: This Dawn, unprecedented, the dear one of the sky, shines forth — I praise the two lovely Aśvins greatly.

sanskrit: indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ . jaghāna navatīrnava
english: Indra, unapproachable, with the bones of Dadhīca smote the obstacles — ninety-nine he slew.

sanskrit: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ . mahāṃ abhiṣṭirojasā
english: Come, O Indra, exhilarate yourself with all the soma-pressings — the great one, powerful in conquest.

sanskrit: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi . mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ
english: Come, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, come to our side — the great one with great aids.

sanskrit: ojastadasya titviṣa ubhe yatsamavartayat . indraścarmeva rodasī
english: His might gleams in that — when he rolled both together, Indra spread the two worlds apart like a hide.

sanskrit: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim . vacastaccinna ohase
english: This one is like a pigeon carrying an embryo toward you, O equal one — do you not carry that speech for us?

sanskrit: vāta ā vātu beṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde . pra na ayūṃṣi tāriṣat
english: May the Wind blow its medicine, bringing peace and joy to our heart — may it extend our life-spans for us.

sanskrit: na kiḥ sa dabhyate janaḥ
english: That person is not deceived by anyone.

sanskrit: gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purāśvayota rathayā . varivasyā mahonām
english: As before with cattle, with horses, and with chariots — honor us with the bounty of the great ones.

sanskrit: imāsta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṃ duhata āśiram . enāmṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ
english: These dappled cows of yours, O Indra, milk clarified butter mixed with milk — swollen full with the immortal.

sanskrit: ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāmanpuruṣṭuta . yatsomesoma ābhuvaḥ
english: By this thought and by the prayer for cattle, O much-named, much-praised one — when you, O Soma, arose as Soma.

sanskrit: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī . yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ
english: May Sarasvatī, pure, rich in nourishment, possessing strength — she who is wealthy in prayer — desire our sacrifice.

sanskrit: ka imaṃ nāhuṣīṣvā indraṃ somasya tarpayāt . sa no vasūnyā bharāt
english: Who among the Nahuṣa-folk would satisfy Indra here with soma? Let him bring us riches.

sanskrit: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam . edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama
english: Come here — for the way is good for you, O Indra — drink this soma; this sacred grass is my seat.

sanskrit: mahi trīṇāmavarastu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ . durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya
english: Great and lowest among the three, gleaming in the sky — the might of Mitra and Aryaman, and the unconquerable power of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayamindra praṇetaḥ . smasi sthātarharīṇām
english: We, O Indra, O much-wealthy one, O guide, are yours — we stand as holders of your tawny steeds.
